title: AVE capability catalogue entry
description: What one tool, identified by its purl, can do - recorded as individual claims, each with public evidence. A capability the entry does not claim is unknown, never absent. See SCHEMA.md, 'Capability catalogue'.

source.description: The tool's identity: the same purl a lock records in a tool's `source`. The file lives at catalogue/<type>/<namespace>/<name>.json.

reviewed.description: When the claims were last checked against their evidence.

summary.description: What the tool is, and anything a reader needs before trusting the claims.

claims.description: May be empty: an entry whose sources established nothing still records that the tool was reviewed, and why each capability stayed unknown.

unknown.description: Capabilities the reviewer considered and could not establish, with the reason. Informational: the matcher treats them exactly like capabilities the entry never mentions.

advisories.description: AVE ids whose conditions or references concern this tool.

present.description: true: the tool has the capability wherever this claim applies. false: it definitely does not - the only way a catalogue entry can clear a match, so it needs the strongest evidence.

versions.description: The tool versions this claim applies to. Omitted means every version.

when.description: The configuration this claim depends on, tested against the lock's tool entry. A field the lock does not record leaves the claim unknown.

note.description: What the source says that supports the claim. Paraphrase or short quote; never a payload.

capability.description: Must equal the lock schema's capability vocabulary; tools/validate.py checks the two lists are identical.
